notes: This older headless browser was used only because current Playwright browser downloads were blocked and the sandbox had no browser.
The result is not a current-Chromium performance result and is not evidence about Scripting WKWebView or physical iOS graphics.

failure.impact: Gen1Recomp has 11 literal bit-module imports and hundreds of bit operations; unmodified love.js cannot boot all required paths.

compatibilityShim.integration: Packaged as a root-level bit.lua compatibility overlay; no Gen1Recomp core or LÖVE source was modified.

parity.coverage: boundary values, signed/unsigned conversion, all shift counts modulo 32, rotates, byte swap, hex width/case, variadic operations, 2,000 deterministic random triples, fractional tie-to-even conversion, infinities, NaN and empty-argument errors

results.filesystem.previousSession: pass: marker state reported for reload tests
results.loop.fixedStep: pass: accumulator advanced deterministic 1/60 ticks and state
results.audio.queueableBuffer: pass: generated buffer queued; audible output not tested
results.thread.newThreadCapability: symbol present but worker creation failed in love.js normalization layer
results.thread.workerFallback: pass: unavailability detected without crashing; upstream no-thread fallbacks required

persistence.conclusion: Persistence exists in this browser, but lifecycle-safe durability requires a serialized explicit sync/flush barrier; immediate navigation can race the asynchronous write.

notProven: Scripting main runtime or WKWebView execution
audible audio after a user gesture
audio queue scheduling and interruption recovery
simultaneous touch, controller support or cancellation recovery
durable persistence under Scripting suspend/termination; only browser reload with an explicit/settled sync was demonstrated
complete parity of every upstream no-thread fallback; love.thread.newThread was present but unusable in the tested runtime
Gen1Recomp launcher, fixture or full payload boot
ROM import, saves, mods, visual parity or sustained memory
